item.title: ConformTxt 0.6.29
item.description: - In emails, a list now sits right under its heading or lead-in line, the way it does in Word and Pages. The empty line after the list stays. - The installer window shows the version ("ConformTxt 0.6.29"). - In History, a long app name now shortens first, so "Matched" and the time always show in full.
